title: aspidium auriculatum
intro: Aspidium auriculatum, commonly known as the Golden Polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against infections and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium auriculatum include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium auriculatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
